artifacts.summary: Six-phase, 6-hour plan discharging the ModelChecker-side contract handoffs: verify the three already-landed items, fix the shape-dispatch defect in Sentence.update_types, remove the corpus workaround it caused, and wire the fixture-based translation conformance channel plus an optional live differential leg.

memory_candidates.content: When a defined nullary operator (e.g. \top defined as \neg \bot) is mishandled by an operator-elimination pass, check whether the branch dispatches on the ORIGINAL surface name rather than on the SHAPE of the already-derived type. Name-keyed dispatch after a derivation step is a recurring defect class: it silently mixes pre-derivation and post-derivation vocabularies in one branch. The shape-keyed rewrite is usually behavior-identical for genuinely primitive operators (their derived type really is one element) and only changes the defined ones -- which makes the blast radius checkable in advance by surveying which consumers declare the operator primitive.
